crossRefs.note: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasures.

people.name: Gershom
people.line: Son of Moses; father of Jonathan, a renegade priest.

people.name: Shebuel
people.line: Levite descendant of Gershom, in charge of treasuries

translations.web: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
translations.bsb: The descendants of Gershom: Shebuel was the first.
translations.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
translations.asv: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
